title: Read-only Claude reviewers cannot run `engram source --root ROOT --json`, so they cannot read the candidate's source_id
outcome: Read-only Claude reviewers cannot run `engram source --root ROOT --json`, so they cannot read the candidate's source_id
acceptance: A read-only Claude review child can run `engram source --root <its review root> --json` through the existing read-only Bash gate and receives the complete source_id.

The read-only Bash gate still refuses every other `engram` subcommand and every `engram source` form that names a root outside the child's review root, writes a file, or takes an argument other than `--root` and `--json`.
Focused tests of the read-only Bash gate cover the accepted form and the refused forms, through observable allow/refuse decisions.
